title: Small-bias failure set
statement: For a natural number $n$ and real number $\varepsilon$, the failure set consists of sample sequences of binary cubes of length $n$ that are not $\varepsilon$-small-biased.
caveat: The definition of the $\varepsilon$-small-biased sample property is not supplied.
